result:
Nothing needed restarting or tuning this run, so I made no changes. The report, `status.json` and one line in `foreman_actions.log` are written.

- **Running:** all 8 FEBio runs are moving; every log was written in the last 6 s.
  - mu 0.3 reruns: p036 flexion, p039 flexion and extension, p101 flexion.
  - Cycle tests on p124: cyc3vrN and cyc3vdt.
  - Push-out test p140 (push_post2).
  - ASTM p064 shear45: at t 0.66 after 2.9 h.
- **What limits speed:** the 32-core CPU quota. About 29.6 cores are busy, the runs ask for 42 threads, and 69 of 100 periods were throttled.
  - h51 started p039 flexion and extension together at 17:28 when 30 of the 32 threads were already taken. This is a known race in `h51_relG_fallback.py`, which I'm not allowed to edit, so I've put it in "requests" for a person.
- **Waiting, not stuck:** 5 lanes are waiting for free cores — push2 lanes 3/4/5 (about 37 designs) and push2_retry lanes 0/1 (p075, p093, p039, p064).
- **Idle resources:** GPU use is low because the runs are bound by CPU. GPUs 5 and 6 are taken by another user (39.8 of 40 GB each).
- **Memory and disk:** real memory use is 25.5 of 137 GB; the rest is file cache the system can free. There have been no new out-of-memory kills (still 2). Disk has 2.0 TB free.
- **Queues:** the h19 queue and the evo task queue are both empty.
- **Last hour:** 8 runs ended, 6 normally. The other 2 (p039 flexion, p036 extension) have already been handed to the relG fallback and are running again, as designed.
- **Restart cover:** every running lane is covered by `resume_all.sh` (syntax check passes) and all services are up.
- **Still open from earlier:**
  - Nobody has explained what stopped the four ASTM compression runs at 14:48 (p064, p076, p077, p139).
  - Push-out runs p051 and p061 ended in error.
  - 5 mu03rN windows did not end normally.
  - The ops/ changes still need a commit by a person.

The Google Drive connector on claude.ai needs authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings; it can't be used until then.
